motion.$description: Motion as measured: the durations and easing curves the product's elements run, which properties transition, its animations and @keyframes, and what prefers-reduced-motion: reduce changes. Read by tools/capture/motion-probe.mjs.

ease.$description: The keyword `ease`, expanded to its control points.

ease-in-out.$description: The keyword `ease-in-out`, expanded to its control points.

reducedMotion.probe: page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion }): 'no-preference' then 'reduce', same elements, same page

notTokenised.name: section.subscription
notTokenised.why: declared and not mounted. The same blue paints on the GSCT link, which is color.linkBlue

notTokenised.name: section.projects-upcoming-and-links border-image
notTokenised.why: a gradient border, not a flat colour; the section's own computed border-left-color is the Tailwind default rgb(229, 231, 235) because border-image replaces it

notTokenised.name: input
notTokenised.why: declared; no input is in the DOM. The only textarea is a hidden g-recaptcha-response

notTokenised.name: placeholder
notTokenised.why: Tailwind preflight on input::placeholder; no placeholder is painted

notTokenised.name: .row .left width
notTokenised.why: a ch length; spacing.indexCol stores the computed 26px index size instead

notTokenised.name: .row .right width
notTokenised.why: a ch length; the title column is not a px token

notTokenised.name: motion easing steps(50, end)
notTokenised.why: an easing DTCG's cubicBezier cannot carry (steps() or a linear() curve)
